ON THE 12th OF DECEMBER, 2024  CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 11933 of 2024  RIYASAT KHAN  Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS  Appearance:
 Shri Ravi Vallabh Tripathi - Advocate for the appella  Shri Saket Udeniya - Public Prosecutor for the respon  Shri Arvind Kumar Dwivedi- Advocate for the responden  No.2/complainant.
 ORDER 1 . Heard on I.A. No.25458/24, which is an application filed under Section 338(2) of BNS for seeking permission to assist the prosecution.
After due consideration, the application is allowed.
Shri Arvind Kumar Dwivedi, Advocate and his associates are permitted to assist the learned Public Prosecutor.

2. This criminal appeal under Section 14-A(2) of the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities) Act has been filed against the order dated 18.10.2024 passed by Special Judge (SC/ST) District Gwalior (M.P) in Bail Application 2713/2024 whereby the application moved by the appellant for grant of bail under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been rejected in NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:22091 2 CRA-11933-2024 connection with Crime No.127/2024 registered at Police Station Huzrat Kotwali, District Gwalior for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 294, 506 of IPC read with Section 3(2)(v), 3(1)(r), 3(1)(s), 3(1)(w)
(ii), 3(1)(w)(i) of Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 and under Section 67, 67(a) of IT Act.

sentences.text: The allegation against the present appellant is that he took away the prosecutrix by persuading her and thereafter committed rape on her.
The applicant also prepared a video on the basis of which he used to call her by threatening to viral her video.
4. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the present appellant that the prosecutrix was 35 years old while, the present appellant is 32 years old.
He is in custody since 01.08.2024.
Charge-sheet has been filed on 30.09.2024.

As per the story of prosecution, the present appellant by cajoling and enticing the prosecutrix has taken her with him and thereafter committed rape on her and her video has been prepared but the DNA report which has been received is negative against the present appellant.
No video or mobile chatting has been seized by the Police.
He is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the incident.
There is no criminal antecedent against him.
Further, the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the preosecutrix has also expressed his no objection on the application of the applicant.
He is ready and willing to abide by all the terms and conditions which may be imposed by this Court.
Conclusion of trial will take time.
On these grounds, learned counsel prays for grant of bail to the appellant.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:22091 3 CRA-11933-2024 5.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the bail application and prays for its rejection.
6. Learned counsel for the complainant has expressed no objection for granting the bail application.

7. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
8.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this appeal is allowed by setting aside the order dated 18.10.2024 passed by Special Judge (Atrocities), Gwalior, in Bail Application No.2713/2024 and it is directed that the appellant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

In case, if he is found involving in the offence of the same nature, this bail Riyasat Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163445897/
2 order shall stand cancelled NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:22091 4 CRA-11933-2024 automatically without further reference to the Bench.
